title: Compose pre filter shaper clipper DC blocker and tone filter in processing chain
description:
Create Source/DSP/ShredBoostEngine.h and Source/DSP/ShredBoostEngine.cpp composing the phase-d DSP stages into the binding processing chain order. This engine owns and sequences: the Transient Pick-Attack Shaper (d.1, TransientShaper), the Nonlinear Clipper (d.2, NonlinearClipper), the DC Blocker (d.3, DcBlocker), and the post-drive Tone LPF (d.3, ToneFilter), invoked in binding chain order [3] TransientShaper -> [5] NonlinearClipper -> [7] DcBlocker -> [8] ToneFilter. Preserve slots for the earlier pre-filter/oversampling stages and later output stages so this composition drops into the full chain without reordering.

Provide prepare(double sampleRate, int maxBlockSize), reset(), setters that forward smoothed parameters (pick_attack, voicing_mode, tone) to the owned stages, and a process method that runs the owned stages in order on a juce::dsp::AudioBlock or float buffers.

Binding real-time rules: no heap allocation, locks, file IO, or string construction in processBlock; instantiate juce::ScopedNoDenormals at the top of the process method; allocate all buffers/state during prepare and forward prepare to every owned stage.

Before editing, inspect:
- Source/DSP/TransientShaper.h (d.1), Source/DSP/NonlinearClipper.h (d.2), Source/DSP/DcBlocker.h and Source/DSP/ToneFilter.h (d.3) for the exact prepare/reset/process and setter signatures to call.
- CMakeLists.txt for how Source/DSP files are compiled (do not modify it here).

STRICT FILE SCOPE: Create or modify ONLY the files listed in allowed_write_paths.
acceptance_criteria: Source/DSP/ShredBoostEngine.h/.cpp exist and define a ShredBoostEngine class owning TransientShaper, NonlinearClipper, DcBlocker, and ToneFilter members
The process method invokes the owned stages in binding chain order: TransientShaper -> NonlinearClipper -> DcBlocker -> ToneFilter
prepare and reset are forwarded to every owned stage and juce::ScopedNoDenormals is instantiated at the top of the process method
No heap allocation occurs in the process path; all state is allocated in prepare
No file outside allowed_write_paths is created or modified
forbidden_changes: modify the TransientShaper, NonlinearClipper, DcBlocker, or ToneFilter source files
reorder the binding DSP processing chain
perform heap allocation, locking, or string construction inside the process path

allowed: compose the existing stage classes as members
forbidden: reimplement DSP already provided by the owned stage classes
change any owned stage's public interface
